_comment: Copy to watchos.config.json (gitignored) and fill in — scripts/setup.sh reads it. All values overridable by flags. Endpoints are ordered: first is the DEFAULT entry, the rest are failover fallbacks (SPEC §11). With the embedded tailnet node (SPEC §11.4) endpoints are reached THROUGH the tunnel — list the tailnet FQDN/IP; a LAN literal only makes sense with the tailnet dev-off.

tailnet._comment: authKey = reusable, non-ephemeral key from the Tailscale admin console (Keys ▸ generate). It enrolls the watch node ONCE (identity then lives in app data); re-enroll needs a fresh key. hostname = node name shown in the admin console.
